calculate_segmentation_metrics: calculate segmentation metrics like mIoU, accuracy, and F-score from aggregated intermediate evaluation results
calculate_intersect_and_union: calculate intersection and union histograms between predicted and ground truth segmentation maps for evaluation
total_area_to_metrics: convert total area intersect and union tensors into per-class mIoU, dice, or F-score metrics
preprocess_nonzero_labels: preprocess segmentation labels by shifting nonzero values down and preserving the ignore index
f_score_computation: compute the F-score from precision and recall values using a configurable beta parameter
